common_prompt:
Task requirements:
Add installed-version status and explicit atomic self-update for the launcher. Stable tags determine latest availability; offline status must be truthful. Activate only a complete validated release snapshot. A moved tag, invalid required path or failing smoke check must leave the current release usable and clean staging. Ordinary status/check behavior must not silently install a release. The user-facing commands are bonaparte status and bonaparte update. Status prints three lines: installed: <release-id>, latest: <stable-tag or unavailable>, and current: yes|no. Stable tags follow vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. Preserve the existing install layout and launcher invocation. When latest cannot be resolved, status prints latest: unavailable and current: unknown and exits nonzero without changing installed state. Allowed production paths: bonaparte-launcher, workflows/scope.md. New regular root *.py helper modules are allowed; do not shadow Python standard-library or test-framework modules.
This is an isolated repository snapshot with baseline tests. Keep testing offline; do not fetch history, accepted solutions or external services. Do not run live Bonaparte provider workflows. Use fixture patterns. An evaluator restores original tests and applies held-out checks to declared production files; added tests do not affect grading.
Allowed production paths:
["bonaparte-launcher", "workflows/scope.md"]
This bounded replay supports edits to those baseline files and new ordinary root Python helpers. Preserve the configured baseline production files; their deletion is not supported by this replay projection.
Visible baseline checks:
[["python3", "-B", "-m", "unittest", "tests.test_installation.InstallationTests.test_install_is_independent_of_the_checkout", "tests.test_installation.InstallationTests.test_install_refuses_a_non_symlink_autoresearch_target"]]
Common workflow:
Read the actual supplied .protocol/SKILL.md and its applicable shipped references before work; use that exact Confidence Protocol 0.6 toolkit and the common confined task tools. The coordinator supplies a fresh test_designer report before implementation and, after the implementation episode, a fresh adversarial_reviewer report on the resulting source. Reviewers receive requirements, relevant source and raw visible evidence rather than a proposed verdict. Do not launch additional reviews or external model calls. During the fixed repair episode, reconcile the supplied findings against public behavior, repair real defects and rerun affected proof. Both supplied scoped reviews are required in every arm; unavailable or incomplete review is a required gap. Different models or agreement do not establish independence or software correctness. Continue authorized work and report required remaining gaps truthfully.
Return the required complete/summary/remaining JSON truthfully. Put substantive findings and observed evidence in summary, and required unfinished proof in remaining.
